title: EDI/UBL/PEPPOL Full Send/Receive Flow
phase: Second-Pass Depth Closure — P1 Core Business

key_findings.ubl_generation_method: _export_invoice() on account.edi.xml.ubl_20 (and subclasses); returns (UTF-8 XML bytes, set of errors)
key_findings.xml_trigger: Triggered in account.move.send._hook_invoice_document_before_pdf_report_render() during Send & Print flow; stored in ubl_cii_xml_file binary field on account.move
key_findings.peppol_send_flow: _call_web_service_after_invoice_pdf_render() groups invoices by edi_user, calls _send_peppol_documents() which POSTs to /api/peppol/1/send_document; sets peppol_move_state=processing on success
key_findings.peppol_state_machine: ready -> to_send -> processing -> done (or error); incoming invoices arrive as processing state
key_findings.incoming_processing: Cron polls /api/peppol/1/get_all_documents (direction=incoming); decrypts RSA+Fernet; creates account.move as in_invoice; ACKs via /api/peppol/1/ack
key_findings.proxy_auth: JSON-RPC 2.0 with HMAC-signed refresh token (rotates every 24h) or asymmetric RSA fallback for resync
key_findings.community_vs_enterprise: All EDI/PEPPOL modules are LGPL-3 Community; PEPPOL proxy backend is Odoo IAP service (requires subscription) but client code is open source
